# Community imperfect bilingual corpus

Lab fixtures. Short help-style EN pages paired with deliberately imperfect
RU/DE that reconstruct leftover English documented in public i18n reviews.
Not upstream product strings verbatim.

| Slug | Cited public signal | License note |
|---|---|---|
| `excalidraw-font-picker` | [excalidraw#9326](https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/issues/9326) — Quick search / In this scene / Available fonts | MIT product; fixtures original |
| `excalidraw-toasts` | same issue — embed toast / Web Embed leftovers | fixtures original |
| `ever-sidebar` | [ever-co/ever-teams#4395](https://github.com/ever-co/ever-teams/pull/4395) review — Home / Inbox / Platform / Quick Create | fixtures original |
| `ever-subscribe` | same PR — Subscribe / Subscribing / toast gaps | fixtures original |
| `zulip-copy` | [Zulip RU style guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/stable/translating/russian.html) anti-patterns (login / private / email / feedback left Latin) | fixtures original |
| `homebox-toasts` | [homebox#756](https://github.com/sysadminsmedia/homebox/pull/756) — untranslated toasts / titles before fix | fixtures original |

Gold labels planted leftovers for regression. Perfect P/R here locks the
detector against these community patterns; it is not a claim about live apps.
